```{R}
# Item 2 

# Define prior probabilities
p_T0 <- 0.70
p_T1 <- 0.30

# Define conditional probabilities
p_R0_given_T0 <- 0.95
p_R1_given_T0 <- 0.05
p_R0_given_T1 <- 0.25
p_R1_given_T1 <- 0.75

# (a) Probability that 1 was received
p_R1 <- (p_R1_given_T0 * p_T0) + (p_R1_given_T1 * p_T1)
cat("Probability that 1 was received (a):", p_R1, "\n")

# (b) Probability that a 1 was transmitted given that a 1 was received
p_T1_given_R1 <- (p_R1_given_T1 * p_T1) / p_R1
cat("Probability that a 1 was transmitted given that a 1 was received (b):", p_T1_given_R1, "\n")
```



```{r}
# Item 7 

# Define prior probabilities
p_Amy <- 0.30
p_Ava <- 0.60
p_Jane <- 0.10

# Define error rates
p_E_given_Amy <- 0.05
p_E_given_Ava <- 0.01
p_E_given_Jane <- 0.08

# Calculate overall percentage error
p_E <- (p_E_given_Amy * p_Amy) + (p_E_given_Ava * p_Ava) + (p_E_given_Jane * p_Jane)
cat("Overall percentage error:", p_E * 100, "%\n")

# Calculate posterior probabilities 
p_Amy_given_E <- (p_E_given_Amy * p_Amy) / p_E
p_Ava_given_E <- (p_E_given_Ava * p_Ava) / p_E
p_Jane_given_E <- (p_E_given_Jane * p_Jane) / p_E

cat("Probability Amy wrote it:", p_Amy_given_E, "\n")
cat("Probability Ava wrote it:", p_Ava_given_E, "\n")
cat("Probability Jane wrote it:", p_Jane_given_E, "\n")

# Find most likely to write the program
posteriors <- c(Jane = p_Jane_given_E, Amy = p_Amy_given_E, Ava = p_Ava_given_E)
most_likely <- names(which.max(posteriors))
cat("The most likely to have written the code is:", most_likely, "\n")
```
